there's a better move to make progress. Try to find a stronger option.}) 1...
fxe5+ {Great move! What's next?} 2. Ke4 {[%wrong Black is OK. Try to find a
move to win the e-pawn.] [%hint Put Black in zugzwang so that you can win the
e5 pawn.]} (2. Kg5 $2 e4 {Black can meet Kf4 with e3 and then win the f5 pawn.

material?} 3. Kxe5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a winning
capture.] [%hint Capture a free pawn.] Great play! The f-pawn will win the
game for White.} *
